verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an MCP connection platform, but the evidence documents no sandbox, test mode, or isolation from production data. Uplink lets you test an in-development server against a real agent, and service tokens scope which connections can be called; neither is a sandbox isolated from production data. The shutdown notice also states there is no longer an API surface to sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
